label: PF Backlog 420
title: Backlog analysis staleness: pickup revalidation (arch-version) + deep re-analyze/update + assignment guard + change propagation
body:
PROBLEM: backlog analysis (grooming/deep analysis) is done at entry. By pickup time the architecture/design may have changed. External architecture changes do NOT mark dependent items STALE - only the item's OWN title/body/dependencies/links edits do (core/backlog.py:82 _STALE_FIELDS, :1067). work_pull returns the STORED analysis (pickup = execution, not re-analysis), so a worker can execute on outdated design.

RCCA (5-why): stale design executed -> pickup trusts stored analysis -> external arch changes don't propagate STALE -> staleness trigger is per-item field change only -> analysis records no architecture/contract version. PREVENTIVE GUARD: version-aware analysis + change propagation + pickup revalidation.

FIX (4 parts):
1. VERSION-AWARE ANALYSIS: record the architecture/contract version on analysis at analyze time.
2. PICKUP REVALIDATION: at pickup compare analysis version/revision vs current -> mismatch => STALE.
3. RE-ANALYZE + UPDATE: on stale, deep re-analyze against the current codebase (core/grooming) and UPDATE the stored design/architecture on the item; then it becomes eligible again.
4. GUARD: work_pull refuses assignment while analysis is STALE/version-mismatched.
5. PROPAGATION: when a shared contract/architecture/component changes, mark_stale dependent items (affected_components/links).
6. SAFETY NET: enable periodic_sweep_days>0; extend cadence on_pickup_when_defer -> on_pickup (always revalidate; deep re-analyze only if stale).

Owners: core/backlog.py, core/scheduler.py, core/grooming.py, core/work_pull.py, config/grooming-guidelines.json.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/backlog.py, core/backlog_link.py, core/change_log.py, core/change_registry.py

_note: Analysis staleness: fingerprint + revalidation at pickup + refresh + guard
